text:
I was sitting in class and Mrs. Green said we had to use the computer. I love computer time because we get to play games. But today was weird because the screen kept loading and loading. Suddenly, a scary noise came through the speakers! It sounded like a monster groaning in a cave. My hands were trembling because I thought it was dangerous.

"What is that sound?" asked my friend Billy.

"Maybe the computer is sick," I said.

Then the screen turned blue and a silly song started. The rhythm was fast and a cartoon frog sang a funny song. We were reading the words on the screen and laughing. Mrs. Green treated us to extra recess for being brave. I struggled to stop laughing all day. It was the best day ever.

I had a sleepover with my best friend Sam. We scrambled up the stairs to my room fast. We played video games in my own little league.

"Listen to this cool sound!" Sam yelled loudly.

He jumped on the bed and hit the wall. My neighbor started moaning and groaning about the noise.

"Be quiet or mom will come!" I said.

We ate cake until there wasn't a crumb left. It was enough sugar to make us crazy though. We looked out the window at the snowy scenery. I guarantee we stayed up all night long. Sam pretended he was a king and started his reign. It was the best sleepover ever.

Me and my best friend Sam wanted an adventure. We packed our bags with snacks and my pocket knife. The weather was hot but the scenery was cool. We walked into the dark woods and followed a trail.

Suddenly we heard a loud knock on a hollow tree. We stopped and spread out to look for trouble.

"Did you hear that noise?" Sam shouted loudly.

"I think it is a monster!" I said back.

We looked behind a big bush and discovered a hidden cave. Inside was just a raccoon eating a crumpled newspaper. We started laughing because we were scared for nothing again. We went home and ate stewed carrots for dinner. It was the best day ever but we couldn't contain our giggles.

One day, my younger brother and I went exploring. We walked into the woods behind our big house. The trees were tall and the sky was beautiful. We wanted to find a secret treasure chest there. Unfortunately, my brother dropped the map in a puddle!

"Oh no, what happened to the map?" I yelled.

"I am sorry, it slipped!" he cried.

We kept walking instead of going home. We saw a dark cave bearing a scary sign. A witch brewed a green potion inside. We knew it was dangerous, so we ran away fast. We found a shiny rock near the river. It looked like it fell from heaven. We took it home, earning a big hug from Mom. Exploration is fun but also very scary sometimes.

One day my robot named Zorg got very big. He grew taller than my house and made a loud thumping sound when he walked. He was supposed to be cleaning my room, but he chewed up my homework instead.

"Hey! Stop dumping trash everywhere!" I yelled at him.

Zorg looked at me and his red eye turned blue. "Sorry, I am following a new schedule," he said in a robot voice.

He brought out a giant needle and sewed my backpack shut. I scrambled away fast because he was acting crazy. Suddenly, everyone started cheering because Zorg started dancing. He did the robot dance perfectly. It was weird but also cool.

I was running super fast at recess today. My friend Billy followed me to the slide. We played tag and I touched the slide first. But then I tripped on a big rock. My knee hit the ground hard and it broke the skin. It was stinging really bad and I started crying.

My teacher saw me and swept me up in a hug. She took me inside to the nurse. The nurse put a needle and some water on it. Then she put a big bandage surrounding the cut. I discovered a lollipop in her jar and felt better. My knee stopped hurting but I was hungry again. At lunch, I ate a toasted cheese sandwich. I tried to contain my excitement for gym class later. I had a good feeling about dodgeball.

I sat on the ground and stared at the screen. The loading bar was so slow but it was important. My heart was thumping hard because this was the final level.

My brother walked in and he was playing his guitar. He stopped playing and looked at my game.

"You can do it, Jake!" he yelled loudly.

"I know I can be the greatest," I said back.

The game started and my character was roaming around. I cleared the first room and then I saw the castle. There was a big guard standing by the door. I believed I could win so I jumped high. I hit the button and the guard fell down fast. I ran inside and finally won the game after an hour. I was yearning for this win all day long!

I was waiting for my turn in the big race. My brain felt weird and my hands were sweaty. I grasped the steering wheel of my go-kart tightly. Then the green flag flew and the race started! I zoomed past the other cars really fast. The wind was stinging my face but I didn't care.

"You can do it!" my dad yelled loudly.

I climbed up the big hill on the track. I saw the finish line and I grinned. I was going to win the shiny jewel trophy! My reign as the racing king would begin today. I crossed the line first and everyone cheered.

"That was awesome," my friend said to me.

I thought I was the fastest kid ever. Even the king’s daughter couldn't beat me today.

I was swinging at recess when I saw the puddle. It was huge and looked like a lake for boating. I had my new shoes on but I didn't care. I jumped right in and the mud touched my socks. My friend Sam rode his bike over and laughed at me.

"You are going to get in trouble," Sam said.

"No I won't because it was an accident," I yelled.

I felt anger inside me like a thumping drum. The teacher blew the whistle and we lined up. My shoes were floating in mud and made squishy sounds. When I got home my mom was mad. She said I was risking a grounding. I told her I sold my clean shoes to a mud monster. She did not believe me.

My birthday party was supposed to be at the bungee park. I woke up with a happy feeling and I ran downstairs. My mom was making toasted waffles and they smelled wonderful. But then my dad walked in groaning.

"Unfortunately, the car won't start," he grumbled.

I felt sad because I wanted to climb the big wall. My friends came over anyway. We couldn't go, so we played in the yard. My dog stole a single cupcake and disappeared behind a bush. We laughed so hard we fell on the ground.

"Look out for the danger dog!" my friend Sam yelled.

My mom cleared the table and we ate cake. It wasn't the bungee park, but I didn't even have to comb my hair. It was still the best day ever.

We went hiking in the big woods yesterday. My friend Sam believed there was treasure near the river. We followed a long trail and we were singing loud songs. Suddenly we saw a big dark cave approaching.

"Look at that scary hole!" I yelled at Sam.

We walked inside and it was very dark and cold. I saw a weird red stain on a rock. Then we heard a bear growl! We ran very fast and we simply grabbed a vine. We started climbing up a tree that someone built a fort in. The bear stopped and looked at us but then it swam away.

"That was important to run away!" Sam said.

We were cheering because we were safe. We made a fire and toasted marshmallows. Seeing the bear was scary but the marshmallows were good.

My friends and I went to the dark forest. We wanted to find the secret gold coin. The trees grew very tall and looked scary. Suddenly, the ground shook hard and we fell down.

"Look out for that big hole!" screamed Timmy.

We almost sank into the mud but we jumped. Then a big bat flew right at our heads. I was so scared but I grabbed a stick. I hit the bat and it flew away fast. We found the shiny gold coin behind a rock.

"I guarantee we are rich now," said Sarah.

We ran home and left the scary scene quickly. We were safe and happy with our treasure.

We woke up really early because my dog Spot was barking. We went outside and the sun was hot and scorched the grass. Spot was roaming around a big bush and sniffing it hard.

"What is that weird thing?" I asked my brother.

He looked closer and then he screamed really loud. It was a giant fat toad with bumps on its back. The toad jumped like it was on a bungee cord. It landed right on my foot and it had a lot of weight!

"Get it off me!" I yelled and kicked my leg.

We ran inside and ate roasted marshmallows for breakfast instead. My dad acted like a colonel and marched us to the table. We heard the birds singing outside but we stayed inside safe.

I was walking to school and looking at the scenery. I saw a big meadow next to the playground. My friend Tim followed me and pointed his finger.

"Look at that bug!" Tim screamed really loud.

It was the greatest bug I ever discovered. It had green spots and big wings. We reached out to touch it but the bell rang.

"Oh no, we have to go inside now," I grumbled.

We ran to class and heard the teacher talking. She said recess was going to be longer today! I raised my hand because I wanted to know why.

"Is it for the bug?" I asked her.

She laughed and said no. But I was swearing inside my head that the bug made recess longer. It was the best day ever.

I woke up early because my dog Spot was barking. We went to the forest for a science project. I was looking for bugs but Spot saw a squirrel. He started jumping and running fast. I screamed, "Stop Spot come back here right now!"

Although he is naughty, he is usually a good boy. Spot was climbing a big tree but then he fell. He landed in a pile of mud. It looked like brown stewed tomatoes. Spot shook his fur and was dumping mud everywhere. He threw mud on my new shoes!

"Oh no Spot, Mom will be so mad," I said.

We walked home and I heard birds singing. I almost sold Spot to the neighbors, but then he licked my face. He is silly but I love him.

My birthday party was in the backyard. It was a warm day with a nice breeze. We played tag and then we started a treasure hunt. I drew a map for my friends. We looked everywhere for the gold coins.

"I found it!" shouted my friend Sam.
"Wait, that is just a rock," said Leo.

We laughed and kept looking for the prize. Finally, we saw a red balloon floating near the bushes. The treasure box was hidden right there! It was a pleasure to open it. Inside was a lot of candy.

Then my dog Buster stole a bag of chips! He chewed them up fast. We all started cheering for the silly dog. My dad roasted hot dogs for us. Even though we lost the chips, it was the best day ever.

Me and my younger brother Sam went exploring in the woods. We were looking for bugs but found a fort instead. It was made of sticks and looked like a secret base.

"Be quiet or the guard will hear us," I whispered.

Sam nodded and grasped a big stick for protection. We pretended an invisible monster was keeping watch. Suddenly, a huge black beetle appeared on a log. Sam screamed and crashed into the stick wall. The whole thing fell down on us. I started tearing the sticks away quickly.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"I think I got pneumonia from the dirt," Sam said.

I laughed and pointed at his finger. The beetle was sitting right there already. It looked very different up close. We trained it to walk on a leaf and then we went home for lunch.

I sprinted out of the apartment door because I was late. My legs were pumping super fast all the way to school. I dropped my bag and ran straight to the playground.

"You are late!" my friend Sam yelled by the water fountain.

"My alarm didn't go off," I grumbled back at him.

We played tag on the grass surrounding the big slide. I felt like a champion when I dodged everyone. It was like I had zero gravity in my shoes. Then I tripped on a twisted root on the trail. I fell down hard.

"Are you okay?" Sam asked and helped me up.

I nodded and used my imagination to pretend I was a brave colonel. Being late wasn't so bad after all.

I was hanging upside down on the jungle gym today. It is the best thing at recess. My friend Leo greeted me. He was sounding happy because he had a new ball.

"Look at this!" Leo yelled loudly. "I am the champion of kickball!"

Unfortunately, the bell rang right then. We groaned and walked back inside. Mrs. Miller was drinking her coffee for the caffeine. She looked tired.

"Take out your math homework," she grumbled to the class.

I looked in my backpack but everything was a mess. I simply could not find it! I saw an old newspaper and my lunch, but no math. My face got hot.

"I think my dog ate it," I whispered to Leo.

He laughed at me throughout the whole math lesson. I felt very small in height. Next time I will put it in my folder.

One day me and my dog Buster were exploring the woods. We walked throughout the big trees and looked for bugs. Suddenly Buster started sounding really loud and barking at a squirrel. The squirrel was climbing up a giant oak tree fast. Buster tried to jump but he fell down on the grass.

"Come back here Buster!" I yelled at him.

But he didn't listen and he kept tearing through the bushes. I feared he would get lost in the dark woods. There might be danger like a bear or a snake. I ran after him and grabbed his collar tight.

"You have to be safe," I said.

We walked home and my dad was cooking dinner outside. We ate roasted marshmallows and Buster fell asleep on my feet.

I was eating my lunch and it was pizza day. I love pizza but the sauce is very messy. My neighbor at the table is named Ben. He always likes to complain about the school food.

"This cheese tastes like rubber," Ben said loudly.

I grabbed my slice and tried to take a big bite. Suddenly, the pepperoni fell off and hit my shirt. It made a huge red stain right on the front.

"Oh no!" I yelled. "My mom will be mad."

Mrs. Green neared our table to see what happened. She said we can learn about gravity now. She helped me guide a napkin onto the spot. It did not come off, but at least recess was next.

I knew today was the big race. My sneakers were steady on the dirt. All the kids were surrounding the starting line. I stuck my tongue out because I was nervous.

"Ready, set, go!" yelled my teacher.

I ran fast but my friend Tim was faster. I had a yearning to win the shiny jewel prize. But then Tim tripped on a rock. I caught him before he hit the ground.

"Are you okay?" I asked him quickly.

He nodded and we started running again. It felt different than just winning. We cleared the finish line at the same time! My mom said I might get a grounding if I was late, but I wasn't. Tomorrow we will climb the big hill and race again. I did not knock anyone down and that was good.

I opened my lunch box and saw something weird. My sandwich was gone and there were just crumbs. I looked around the cafeteria but nobody said anything. Then I saw Tommy chewing really fast.

"Did you take my sandwich?" I yelled at him.

Tommy shook his head but his cheeks looked huge. He swallowed hard and then he smiled.

"No, maybe a bug crawled in there," Tommy said.

I knew he was lying because he had peanut butter on his chin. I was so hungry that I felt like I caught a cold or maybe pneumonia. My stomach felt empty and my throat felt dry. Then my friend Sarah gave me her apple. We went outside for recess and the sun felt hot. It roasted and toasted us while we played tag. Sarah was the queen and began her reign over the playground. We spread our arms and ran until the bell rang.

Max put on his backpack and crawled into the vent. It was tight and the weight of his bag felt heavy. He was on a secret mission. A bad guy trapped his cat in the basement.

"This is impossible," Max whispered to himself.

He saw a red light. It was a robot guard! Max remembered his spy training. He threw a rock at the wall. The guard looked away. Max ran past it fast.

He found the main computer room. A green potion brewed in a pot nearby. Max typed the code his dad was teaching him. The cage opened.

"Meow!" said Fluffy.

They ran back to the vent. Max felt his blood pumping in every vein. They escaped without any trouble. Max thought he was the best spy ever.

My dog Buster and I went to the park. The grass felt like an island surrounding us. A cool breeze touched my face. Buster started tearing through the green field. I ran after him fast.

"Wait for me, Buster!" I shouted loud.

He stopped near a big bush. I put my finger on my lips to be quiet. He was bringing me a stick. I gave him a big squeeze. Then we saw a squirrel leaving the tree. It looked like it was in a secret league. We started to search for it, but it was invisible now. The sun rose higher in the sky. My mom sent a text to come home.

"Let's go, boy," I said.

I will remember this fun day forever.

I was sitting at my desk and staring at the ceiling. Math class was feeling longer than a climb up a mountain. My stomach growled because I was so hungry. Finally the bell rang and I ran outside immediately. 

I saw my friend Sam approaching the swings. He grinned at me and waved his hand.

"Do you want to have a race?" Sam asked.

"Yes, but I have super strength today!" I yelled back.

We ran across the playground and my feet felt like they were floating. Neither of us stopped until we crossed the finish line. I tripped on the ground and got a grass stain on my pants. We laughed really hard and then ate our sandwiches. It was the best lunch ever.

My brother and I played the greatest video game ever. The scene was a dark castle with scary monsters. It looked impossible to win because the boss was huge. He was double the height of our characters!

"Jump now or you will lose!" yelled my brother.

I pressed the red button and my character appeared behind the monster. It was an incredible move. The door opened and we saw the treasure chest. It was important to get the gold to win the level.

"We did it! We are the best team," I grinned.

We were happy to receive the big golden trophy. My mom came in and said, "My daughter is a champion!" It took us two hours to complete the game.

I rode my bike to school very fast today. We had science class and learned about gravity. Mrs. Miller dropped an apple and it fell on the ground. Everyone laughed because it made a loud sounding thud. Then we went to recess and played tag near the trail.

"You can't catch me!" shouted my friend Leo.

I ran faster but I tripped and scrambled back up. My knee hurt a little but I didn't get in trouble. After school I went back to my apartment. I had wonderful pizza for dinner but then I felt anger. My mom said I had to maintain my grades.

"Do your homework or no TV," she said.

It took longer than usual but I finished it all.

My nephew Timmy drew a big robot on the paper. The robot had a long metal tongue and red eyes. Suddenly the paper felt like a cool breeze and shook hard.

"Watch out!" yelled Timmy as the robot jumped out.

The robot escaped the paper and crushed my toy car. It was a scary scene in my messy bedroom. I grabbed my mom's big silver scissors to stop it. I cut the robot's leg but it was too strong. Then a tiny gnat flew into the robot's ear. The robot started spinning fast and crashed into the wall.

"The bug broke its design!" I shouted happily.

We had a meeting with my mom about the mess. Next time we will just draw nice flowers.

It was the big day for our soccer game. The weather was hot and the sun was super bright. My coach chose me to be the goalie first. I was trembling a little bit because the other team looked big. They kicked the ball really hard at me. I jumped and twisted my body to catch it. I felt a sharp pain like a needle poked me.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

"Yeah, I think I just landed on a beetle," I said.

The beetle was squished but I saved the goal. It was a pleasure to win the game for my team. My dad read the score out loud and we all cheered. It was the best game ever.

My dog Buddy escaped from the yard yesterday. He was jumping over the fence. I yelled at him to stop but he kept running. He ran past the old tree with the swinging tire. My mom and I looked for him for eight hours. It messed up my whole schedule for the day.

"Where did that bad dog go?" I grumbled.

Suddenly, Buddy appeared from behind a bush. He had a blue feather stuck to his nose. My mom was so grateful to see him. She checked his leather collar to make sure it was okay.

"You are keeping us very busy, Buddy!" my mom said.

We went inside to complete our dinner. I hope I receive a treat too for being good.

My nephew and I were playing a cool pirate game. We had to fight a big, scary sailor boss. He looked very mean and had a red hat. I jumped over him, but he scorched me with fire.

"Oh no! I am in trouble now," I yelled loudly.

My nephew laughed and chewed on his gum. He hit the jump button and escaped the fire. Then he landed right on the sailor's head! The bad guy disappeared into a cloud of smoke.

"We did it! We are winning again!" he shouted happily.

But suddenly a giant dragon came through the wall. It was making a scary sounding noise. We struggled to beat it, but we kept playing. Keeping our score high was super hard work.

My dog Buster and I went exploring in the woods today. We believed there was treasure hidden behind the old barn. My legs were pumping fast as I ran to the trees. Buster led the way with his nose to the ground. 

"Look here Buster!" I shouted and pointed at a big rock.

We reached the rock and I touched the cold stone. I pulled away some vines and saw a small hole. I reached in and obtained a dirty metal box. 

"We did it!" I said to Buster.

Inside the box were five shiny rocks that I counted carefully. My mission was complete. We built a secret fort there to keep them safe. I tried to explain to mom later, but she just laughed. Leading Buster back home was the best part of the day.

It was raining hard outside so we had indoor recess. Everyone was groaning because we wanted to play tag. I opened my lunchbox and saw a big black beetle inside! I screamed really loud and dropped my sandwich.

"Is that a beetle?" asked my friend Max.

"Yes, and it is eating my cheese!" I yelled back.

The beetle had a lot of strength for a tiny bug. It was roaming around my apple slices. I am not trained to handle bugs. Max simply grabbed a napkin and picked it up.

"I am keeping it," Max said with a smile.

Just then, Mrs. Green walked in and almost crashed into Max. She told us to complete our puzzles. It was a crazy day.

My dog Rusty loves roaming in the woods behind my house. One day he escaped the yard and I ran after him. I scrambled over a big log and my shirt got caught. A sharp pine needle poked my arm but I didn't cry.

Suddenly, a beautiful deer appeared right in front of us! Rusty stopped barking and just looked at her. It was like they were having a silent meeting.

"Come back here, Rusty!" I yelled.

He looked at me like he didn't understand.

"Be honest, you just want to chase squirrels," I said.

We walked home and it took almost an hour. Mom made us toasted cheese sandwiches because we were hungry. I swept the dirt off my shoes and promised to learn to shut the gate better next time.

I was playing soccer in the park with my friends. The grass was wet and I was clinging to the ball. Then my nose started tickling and I let out a giant sneeze. It was so loud my ears were ringing.

"You messed up!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball hard but it went the wrong way. It landed right in a puddle of mud. Everyone started groaning and moaning because the ball was dirty.

"We need better coaching," I said to Sam.

Then a big dog appeared and grabbed our muddy ball. He ran away simply dumping mud everywhere. That was the end of my reign as soccer king. Our meeting was over so we just went home.

My birthday party was almost ruined by my little brother. Mom was baking a huge chocolate cake and I was bearing the plates to the table. Suddenly my brother ran in with his toy truck and crashed right into my legs! The plates flew up and smashed on the floor.

"Watch where you are going!" I screamed at him.

He started crying and mom came running in. She looked mad but she didn't yell.

"I will help clean up," my brother grumbled quietly.

He helped me pick up the pieces and was actually nice. Later, my friends came over and we played tag. We screamed loudly when we ran around the yard. I was earning points for every person I tagged. My mom brought out the cake and I felt very grateful. It was the best birthday beyond measure.

My robot friend Zap brewed some green tea for me. He was not a good cook but I didn't complain. We were flying to Mars in his shiny silver ship.

Suddenly, a big wind blew us off the path! We spun around and gradually slowed down near a purple planet.

"Where are we?" I asked Zap.

"This looks like heaven for robots," Zap beeped happily.

A robot sailor greeted us at the dock. He reached out his metal hand to shake mine. He had three eyes and very long legs.

"Welcome to Planet Gear," the sailor said. "Do you like oil?"

I laughed and shook my head. It was going to be a fun adventure.

I was waiting for the big game to start. My friends and I are in a soccer league. The other team looked really tough. They had a giant goalie surrounding the net.

My coach told us, "Just keep pumping your legs!"

The whistle blew and everyone scrambled for the ball. I ran fast like a sailor steering a ship. I kicked it hard, but it wasn't enough. The goalie was jumping everywhere! Then, my friend Leo got the ball. He measured his kick carefully.

"Go Leo!" I was screaming loudly.

He kicked it right past the goalie. We counted the seconds until the game ended. We won the game by beating them one to zero! It was the best day ever.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover. We were playing a game in the basement and jumping around. Sam grabbed the pillow and I grasped it back. We were fighting over the pillow island on the floor.

"You can't catch me!" I yelled really loud.

My dad came downstairs because he heard us screaming. He looked like he was coaching a sports team.

"You boys need to calm down now," he said.

We froze because he looked very serious. Dad started bringing us snacks and water. He said we needed protein to grow big. I think he knows about psychology or something smart. We grew tired after eating the snacks. We stopped roaming around the room and finally went to sleep. The height of the bunk bed was scary but fun. Sam’s mom sent us home the next morning. It was the best night ever.

I was playing my favorite video game about space racing. My spaceship was green and it was getting stronger every second. I feared the big boss level because it was full of danger. Suddenly, my ship disappeared from the screen and everything went black.

"What just happened to my game?" I yelled loudly.

My big brother walked in and he greeted me with a laugh. "I unplugged it because you play too much," he said.

I was so mad and I felt tears tearing at my eyes. I struggled to plug it back in but the cord was tangled. Finally, I fixed it and my ship crossed the finish line. My score was growing huge and I won the whole game!

We rode our bikes to the old house. My younger brother Leo was scared but I was certain. We crossed the big yard and saw a balcony. It looked like it was floating in the air. We walked inside and suddenly heard a thumping sound.

"I want to go home now," Leo grumbled.

"We have to maintain our courage," I said.

We walked up the stairs gradually. Something was bumping against the wall. I pointed my finger at a dark shadow. It was just a bird! We trained our flashlight on it. Later we went home and roasted marshmallows. It was the best adventure ever.

It was my best friend Sam's birthday party. We were playing tag in his big backyard. I ran fast but I tripped on a rock. My knee hurt and I grumbled because it was stinging. 

"Are you okay?" asked Sam.

I nodded and used all my strength to stand up. I gripped my knee but I didn't cry. Then we heard a loud noise. Sam's dog escaped from the house and ran fast! He screeched with excitement. 

"Catch him!" yelled Sam’s mom.

We all chased the dog around the big green trees. I was keeping up with him. Finally, Sam grabbed the leash. Everyone started cheering for us. We went inside and spread frosting on the cupcakes. Nothing went wrong and it was the best day ever.

I was playing my new racing game called Super Cars. The weather outside was rainy, so I played all day. I was steering my red car really fast. The scenery looked blurry because of my speed. My big brother came in and he was eating tacos. He spilled some sauce and made a big stain on the rug.

"Hey, watch out for my game!" I yelled at him.

"Sorry, I didn't see you playing," he said while chewing.

I looked back at the TV but my car was floating. It flew off the track and crashed into a wall. I stewed in anger and started groaning loudly. I really believed I was going to win that race. My car parts were scattered everywhere on the screen. I stopped breathing for a second because I was so mad. Next time I will lock my door so nobody bothers me.

One day I found a shiny jewel near the water fountain. It was glowing green and it looked impossible. Suddenly a robot with big metal arms landed next to me.

"Give me that rock!" the robot shouted loudly.

I was scared and I almost froze. The robot grabbed at me but I ran away fast. I hid behind a newspaper stand. The robot screeched and looked everywhere for me.

"You have to listen to me!" I screamed back.

I threw the jewel at the robot's computer brain. The gravity turned off and the robot floated up high. It fought the air but it was stuck. I designed a trap and I won!

I was so hungry when the bell rang for lunch. I ran to the cafeteria with my heavy backpack thumping on my back. I saw my friend Jake hanging by the door. "Do you have pizza today?" I asked him. He nodded his head and smiled really big.

But then I tripped on a loose shoelace. My lunchbox flew open and food went everywhere. My apple went rolling and my chips scattered on the floor. It was a huge scene. Everyone was dumping their trays and looking at me. I screamed inside my head but I just stood there breathing fast. I remembered what my mom said about counting to ten. I counted slow and then Jake helped me clean up. "Don't worry, I will share my pizza," he said. I was so happy I didn't get a grounding for making a mess.

It was raining on my birthday so we sat inside. I was yearning for chocolate cake all day long. My mom made a huge cake and put candles on it. My friends came over and we played video games together.

"Happy birthday to you!" they sang really loud.

I blew out the candles and the smoke flew everywhere. Then my dog stole a piece of cake off the table! He is growing so big and he eats everything.

"Bad dog!" my dad yelled but he was actually laughing.

We ate the cake gradually because it was very rich. I had to learn how to maintain my high score later. The pile of presents grew bigger on the floor. It was the best birthday ever even with the rain.

My younger brother Sam wanted to play in the mud. He was jumping and jumping in a big puddle. I told him our mom would be mad. But Sam did not listen to me for some reason. He pretended he was a brave knight fighting a dragon.

"Look at me splash the monster!" Sam yelled loudly.

Suddenly, we heard a loud thumping noise behind the bushes. It was our big dog, Buster! He ran right into the mud too. Now they were both super dirty.

"Oh no, we have to start cleaning," I said.

We walked home and I decided to be honest. I told Mom what happened. She laughed and gave us the hose. It was actually really fun to wash the dog.

I put on my green sweater because it was cold outside. My dog Rex was jumping up and down by the door. He really wanted to go to the park for some company. I grabbed his leash and we ran out the door. We walked leading the way to the big water fountain.

Suddenly, Rex saw a squirrel running through the bushes. He pulled hard and turned me around in a circle! "Stop it, Rex!" I yelled at him. The squirrel ran up a tree like a sharp needle. Rex barked loud and I started laughing. "You are a silly dog," I said to him. Then we heard people cheering for a soccer game nearby. We sat down and watched the game together. It was a very fun day outside with my best friend.

My teacher gave us a huge project for homework today. We had to design a special island for a bird. I worked hard on my map and used lots of green. I drew a big tree bearing red fruit for the birds to eat.

Then I scrambled to find a real feather for the nest part. My mom helped me measure the cardboard box so it fit. I used glue but I got it on my fingers.

"This looks great!" my mom said to me.

I smiled because I knew I was earning a gold star. But then I accidentally dropped my hot cocoa on it. The hot milk scorched the paper and it turned brown.

"Oh no!" I yelled really loud.

It was ruined, so I just drew a new one quickly.
